quest.title: Revelations from the Past
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4, The Cornerstone of Stars and Flames x1

talks.objective: Go to the entrance to the ruins

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So the ruins below are the ruins of the... what was he called again? The Sage of the Stolen Flame? Still, the entrance looks like something weird's blocking it...

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: Just as I thought... the Sage's trial has already begun.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Err?

choices.text: Do we need to break that barrier...?

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: I'm afraid that barrier is difficult to break... With all due respect, we must use the correct method to open it.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: *ahem* According to the accounts of the ancient scrolls of our tribe...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: The Sage of the Stolen Flame seemed to have strongly believed that humans could guide and lead Saurians, thus attaining a future far brighter than the age of the ancient giant dragons.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Perhaps he felt guilty, for he stole the secrets of using phlogiston from none other than dragonkind... And this gnawing guilt led to a hope that humans and Saurians could get along, living in peace as equals.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Perhaps that is what drove him to leave behind the token here... According to the ancient scrolls, "Humans and Saurians both have their places..."

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Err?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's about as clear as mud.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Sorry, forgive my ineloquence... I believe it means that <color=#00E1FFFF>humans and dragons must each stand in their respective positions</color> to receive the token.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Still... To ask a Saurian to act in accordance with what a human wants is difficult indeed.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: This too is part of the tribe's trials... The reason one must cultivate an understanding between human and Saurian.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, though Paimon doesn't totally get what you're saying, when it comes to an invisible bond, we're la creme de la creme!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Isn't that right, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Haha, that's the spirit. Now, please try opening the barrier blocking the entrance.

choices.text: Didn't think I'd have to use my wall-phasing jutsu so soon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As if you could even do that!

talks.objective: Open the barrier blocking the entrance to the ruins

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Wraah... Waah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #That's the first time Paimon's heard {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} make that sound.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, he's got a point, this is a huge mural! Hmm, let Paimon look... Two people, each holding something round in their hands...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what's with one of them having a weird head?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rraa?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is it a... dragon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, now that you mention it, it does kinda look like a dragon's head...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Paimon gets it. It actually depicts a dragon and a person, each holding a golden ring.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Paimon feels like she just heard a story about two people taking something or other not long ago...

choices.text: It was the tale Pacal and Manqu were discussing...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Like Paimon said, it did remind her of something she'd just heard...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* But if that was really the case... doesn't that mean that of the Sage of the Stolen Flame and the first Pyro Archon... that one of them was a dragon? But which one of them?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: First, we can rule out the Pyro Archon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so that means... that the Sage of the Stolen Flame is actually a dragon? Right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon recalls that you saw the same golden design on that floating island...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that Sage was also behind us falling into that place when we first came to Natlan, and is also linked to dragons...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Chosen of Dragons"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... So that means that the message back then didn't mean "chosen by the great Tepetlisaurus there"... but by this Sage?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #Or perhaps chosen by {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's possible too... Hmm... Strange...

response.speaker: NPC#21618
response.text: Chosen of Dragons... Come forward... Come forward...

response.speaker: NPC#21618
response.text: Pass through the corridors to your left and right. The path will unfold before your eyes...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Hrrr?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's the matter?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (The golden design says...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do we have to go through from both sides? Hmm, but it looks like both entrances each have their own barriers and mechanisms... Could it be that humans go one way, and dragons the other?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wrroh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #P—Paimon can't even see this time... {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, do you think it's too hard? If it is, we can still back out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If it's really too much, we can wait until you're ready and try again. Not like these ruins are going anywhere.

choices.text: No need to push yourself too hard.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Mraaa... Wrroh... Wraa...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}... You're a brave fella, aren't ya?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, get out as fast as you can if things get dangerous! Nothing is more important than your life, not even treasure.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Err?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't say things he can't understand!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

choices.text: If you want to stop, just say so.
About the first Pyro Archon and the Sage of the Stolen Flame...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A path through the lava has appeared... Looks like the trial is almost over.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That guy from the Saurian Relics Association and the chubby chap from the Children of Echoes kept talking up how dangerous it was, but it looks like there really was nothing to it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: In that case, lead the way, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! You can't even see the bottom... But we're good friends, so of course we'll go together!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrooo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, look! Hehe, we're nearly done!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Wrroh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you see some strange things, too?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't be afraid...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon and I are here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yeah... Though Paimon isn't sure what happened, {NICKNAME}'s right. No matter what, you've got us!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Roooah... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, looks like he's finally perking up! Okay, looks like we can continue downward... This place does feel kinda dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21618
dialogues.text: Chosen of Dragons... Proceed... Eliminate the enemy from the realm beyond...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21618
dialogues.text: Then you will be granted entry into the final paradise.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Ehrrr?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems there's danger below after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did the golden designs tell you that too?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Okay, then let's rest a bit, {NICKNAME}! We'll keep going once you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... Looks like the real entrance to the ruins is over there! And just like the entrance to the first tunnel, there's a strange barrier.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yes, just like at the entrance. {NICKNAME} must stand <color=#00E1FFFF>below the yellow device</color> on the left, while {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} stands <color=#00E1FFFF>below the green device</color> to the right...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Though, it's pretty high up this time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And the route is different too...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rooo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't worry, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! We'll only be separated for a little bit, but we'll still be in sight!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you're scared, just raise your claws towards us and roar as loud as you can!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll wave back, so don't be scared, okay?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Raah, raah... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't talk like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! What if you actually manage to "rawr" something in its language, and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} misunderstands?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr, rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, don't you look happy all of a sudden.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon just doesn't get you. When are you happy, and when are you scared?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Roo?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure seem to be in good spirits! Alright then, let's try opening up that gate.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, try going over there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And once it's open, we'll meet in front of the door!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Paimon never imagined there'd be something like this under the lava. So we're really deep underground now, aren't we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that Sage with the totally impossible name... Hid the token here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21618
dialogues.text: In this place, I made a pledge with Xbalanque...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21618
dialogues.text: Now, let go and let the future of humans and Saurians be as it may. Only the enemy cloaked in shadow shall not be forgiven.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21618
dialogues.text: Chosen of Dragons, prove yourself by facing the mighty foe, that you may ascend the sacred mountain from this place.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, what's going on? That sudden chill...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: S—Something's coming out!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, you did it, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! Great job!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon's not sure why, but it feels like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is getting more and more reliable! That gives Paimon a kind of happy feeling, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Feels way more reliable than Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, no way! And don't you dare agree with {M#him}{F#her}! Meanies, Paimon praises you two just a bit and this is what she gets...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: ...Rraa?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: ...Ooroo, Rooah? Wrroh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... You mean Paimon? Paimon's not angry, and she's not crying!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: ...Ooroo, rawr? Rawr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, fine, fine! Paimon'll "rawr"! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

choices.text: I feel like I can understand him...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's what happens when you spend a lot of time together! Sometimes, Paimon can tell what you're going to cook the moment you reach into your bag to fish out the ingredients...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Hmm, yeah, mmm, hrmm, okay, it's probably... Teyvat Fried Egg!" And Lo! Paimon was right.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon, you're terrifying!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! Paimon's got a lot more aspects that are really scary, you just haven't seen them before! ...Whew, Paimon's getting hungry just talking about it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We should hurry up and find the token... Once we find it, we can have a huge feast to celebrate!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Okay, let's move out!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

choices.text: Maybe we've finally got a connection?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it looks like this stone tablet lit up!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Touch the stone tablet...)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As the golden lines light up, shining brilliantly, a fragmented scene surfaces in your mind:

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The eyes of the great dragon, split in two by the sword of the children of man.\nA seal split asunder, engraved upon the white discs, is mistakenly classified as a hole.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: One was given to the silver dragon's white claws, one to the resurrected corpse.\nOne was buried beneath the great monument, and one was swallowed into the belly of the headstrong one.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A white disc appears beneath your feet, the other obscured in shadow. The great wings shadowing it are raised, and you finally see its drawn, upright pupils.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You hear a voice. It says:\n"Glory, glory, the Eternal Empire, Ochkanatlan"\nYou see the person standing before the empty throne, picking up that disc, turning around, and looking at you...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #"Wake up, {NICKNAME}, please wake up..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! You finally responded! When you touched that stone tablet, you just froze up and wouldn't react to anything...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But look over there！ A round plate with golden etchings on it appeared on the ground! That should be the token we're looking for.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A golden seal... Engraved on a white disc...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What're you saying?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you probably are tired! After all, we sure did a lot today. Let's rest up after we get back!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This token looks kinda like a big, round plate... Hmm, so in the mural, both the human and the dragon each had discs like this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, we got a token! Let's take it back and show it to Manqu!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it looks like this stone tablet lit up!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Touch the stone tablet...)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As the golden lines light up, shining brilliantly, a fragmented scene surfaces in your mind:

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The eyes of the great dragon, split in two by the sword of the children of man.\nA seal split asunder, engraved upon the white disc, is mistakenly classified as a hole.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: One was given to the silver dragon's white claws, one to the resurrected corpse.\nOne was buried beneath the great monument, and one was swallowed into the belly of the headstrong one.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The two white discs appear beneath your feet.\nYou pick them up, and the golden seal combines into one, as they merge into one.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Soon, you see your face reflected in massive dark pupils.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #"Wake up, {NICKNAME}, please wake up..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! You finally responded! When you touched that stone tablet, you just froze up and wouldn't react to anything...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But look! The token we're looking for is on the ground, just like the one we found before.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A golden seal... Engraved on a white disc...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What're you saying?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you probably are tired! After all, we sure did a lot today. Let's rest up after we get back!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Okay, that's both tokens... Now {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} should have the right to get cured at the volcano, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay! Let's bring the tokens and go find Manqu!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} looked like he got way stronger... Hmm... Just like at the end of our adventure in Ochkanatlan...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Definitely looks stronger.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Raooo...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He was absolutely killing it during that fight...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, most impressive.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr... Rrrooo...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Ehrr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm, it looks like that's not a power {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} can just use whenever.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Though, Manqu did say that it's better not to use power like that too much anyway.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #*sigh* ...So where did that weirdo with the hard-to-remember name hide the token? All Paimon wants to do right now is grab {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} and get the heck outta here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, there's another mural here! Now, what's it show...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A huge black dragon, a tree, and some strange person?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Wrroh... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rraa?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21618
dialogues.text: Chosen of Dragons... Come forward... Reach out...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21618
dialogues.text: Reach out your hand... Behold... The sin that will obliterate all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What's wrong, {NICKNAME}? Why are you just staring at the mural?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Reach out towards the mural...)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You witness with your own eyes the gargantuan wings from beyond the world, the once glorious and grand figure now pitiable, having completely sunk into the terrifying shadow.\nThe pitch-black flames scorch the land, and even the white tree nearly withered, and the final envoy's glow shattered and smashed, only able to subsist on the last leaves of the severed roots.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The ancient battlefields brought only destruction.\nAfter that time, specters stirred, evil lurking within the dark, and filth flooded forth.\nOnly the last leaves still shimmered in the night, and after that time, only the last leaves in the night swayed with the ripples in the sea of memory.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text:
Then, you see something else.
But you quickly realize, it is not "you" who sees it.
"You will understand someday." A voice that seems not to be what it appears whispers by your ear, as though it were laughing softly.
But you know, this isn't meant for "you."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You see the entire city's annihilation, the buildings collapse, the ash-white monoliths squeezed in midair as they are turned to powder.\nYou see a giant dragon with pupils pierced and a tiny human falling together from a great height, while the world echoes with a sorrowful song, one composed of the agony of dragonkind.\nYou see a man rising from the dead dragon's heart once more, his whole body seemingly wreathed in flame.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrooo...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Roooah... Ooroo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, are you okay? You weren't moving a muscle...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What I saw might be kinda hard to explain...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Paimon didn't see anything at all! And we're both looking at the same picture... Are you just way more perceptive than Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Roar!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ah! That's {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s voice! Sounds like it's coming from over there... Oh, Paimon sure hopes nothing bad happened...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hurry up, we need to go look!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa, it looks like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} just got stronger! Did something awaken, maybe? Like the power of the Flamelord or something...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Definitely looks stronger.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Raooo...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He was totally rocking during that fight, and was a really big help...

dialogues.speaker: Player
